- **`show_liked_albums`**: GET `/liked_albums`; params: `access_token` (required), `page_index` (optional, default 0), `page_limit` (optional, default 5, 1–20), `sort_by` (optional, default `-liked_at`, valid attributes: `liked_at`, `title`); response: array with `album_id`, `title`, `genre`, `artists`, `rating`, `like_count`, `review_count`, `release_date`, `song_ids`, `liked_at`

instruction: Like all the songs and albums in my Spotify song and album library, respectively, that I have not liked yet.
